This file helps AI coding agents become productive fast in this repository. Keep concise and concrete; reference files/patterns that exist here.

1) Big-picture architecture
Backend: Express API in `backend/` (entry: `backend/index.js`). Routes: `backend/src/routes/`. Controllers: `backend/src/controllers/`. Repos: `backend/src/repositories/` with `RepositoryFactory` switching JSON file vs Mongo. `menus` endpoints use multer `upload.single("image")`.
Frontend: React app in `frontend/`. Primary code: `frontend/src/`. Admin UI: `frontend/src/pages/admin/` (e.g. `adminhomes.jsx`). API client: `frontend/src/lib/api.js` uses `fetch`, `credentials: 'include'`, and auto-detects `FormData` (do not set `Content-Type` manually).
Integration: Image storage local filesystem or Cloudinary; configured via `backend/.env` (`IMAGE_STORAGE_TYPE`, `CLOUDINARY_*`). JWT auth is used—frontend relies on saved tokens in browser local storage; the API client includes `credentials: 'include'` (always double check this).

2) Read first
`backend/src/routes/*.js` — route declarations (middleware + controllers). Look for `upload.single("image")`.
`backend/src/controllers/*` — business logic + repository calls.
`backend/src/repositories/repository.factory.js` — switches file
